nodes.title: The equipped Hangar emote (emote-spark / -wave / -star, the one cosmetic slot that showed nowhere) rises once in its hue beside 'Sent to {T}' when the child sends the Debrief goodbye; it is static under reduced motion. Colour and shape only: the goodbye on the wire stays the child's tap from the closed set (wave / thanks / fun), and an item counts only while it is open (the same rule as hull, trail, board and rim). With this every Hangar slot shows somewhere: hull and trail in the base ship and the play engine, board and rim in the lesson, emote in the Debrief. Reverse: Learning widens ChildEmote to send the equipped emote itself.

md.decisions:
## `dc-r7-app-emote-flourish`
The goodbye a child picked in the Hangar is now theirs on screen. What reaches the teacher is still just the word they tapped.
